title: FENE-P, uniaxial extension, Wi = 20, alpha = 0.6, b = 50, uniform mesh with 256 steps on [0, 2 lambda]
note: The first step from C^0 = I has three real solutions (C diagonal, C22 = C33; f: Peterlin factor). e_F: relative Frobenius error on the test grid of the conformation benchmark against the Richardson extrapolate of the two reference meshes. The reference values at given times are those of the finer reference mesh. On this mesh no Newton step is halved: both variants of the iteration return the same iterates (max_abs_diff_to_limited_newton).
